reviewers.summary: A current, verbatim witness can still be routed as a missing requirement when it clearly states that the requirement is satisfied.

findingList.message: The negation check misses clear statements that requirements are satisfied, so a valid citation denying a gap can establish a MissingRequirement request.

evidence.codePathTraced: WitnessProblem rejects quotes matching a fixed negation regex, then Validate marks a claim Supported when its text appears in the quote and its typed value is present. FindingRouter routes supported MissingRequirement claims as requests.
evidence.failureScenario: With complete coverage, a current page says “All maintenance requirements have been satisfied.” An investigator submits that exact sentence as a MissingRequirement claim and uses “maintenance requirements” as the typed value. The quote passes the witness checks, the negation regex does not match, and routing returns Request despite the evidence denying a gap.

reviewers.summary: The changed tests cover the listed witness and digest checks, coverage and uncertainty routing, and instruction-inert behavior. I found no concrete defect against the acceptance criteria.

Witness identity, digest, page, and quote checks are present. A claim can still be labeled MissingRequirement when its exact supporting text describes a resolved or historical condition, allowing an unsupported request.

findingList.message: A verbatim quote and typed-value match do not establish a current missing requirement. Validate that the evidence supports the claim kind before marking it Supported; otherwise a historical mention can create a request. OWASP A08:2025.

evidence.codePathTraced: Validate accepts claim text that appears verbatim in a witness quote and rejects only a fixed set of negation words. It does not check whether the quote supports the supplied MissingRequirement kind; FindingRouter routes any Supported claim of that kind as a request.
evidence.failureScenario: A current document contains “Maintenance is complete; pending reserve approval is a historical note.” An investigator submits that exact text with typedValue “pending reserve approval” and kind MissingRequirement. The witness and digest checks pass, the negation pattern does not match, and routing creates a request based on evidence that describes a historical note rather than a current gap. OWASP A08:2025.
